newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar wanders in range, follows NY ton.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar wanders in range, follows NY ton.

text.p: Trading ranges on LIFFE nearby white sugar futures widened only slightly in light Monday afternoon activity as the raws market held in a range and failed to boost sentiment in London.

Traders said despite an initial flurry of selling in New York, the spot May raws contract managed to hold above nearby support and so London's equivalent whites contract was content to meander in a tight $2.00 range.
"There's no volume in either market...it's the same old story," said one, adding that little action was likely in the London market while May raws continued to move in a range of around 10 points.
Some light activity was reported on the nearby May/May arbitrage but interest was still generally thin.
Market sources have said London will either need a dose of fresh fundamental news to break out of its recent lethargy or New York's May contract to move away from its stifling ranges.

At 1710 GMT May was down 60 cents at $306.80, about mid-range for the day. August was 80 cents lower at $305.30 and the two front months accounted for the bulk of the light overall volume of 526 lots.
Volume was higher on the Paris market at 786 lots, with 706 traded in spot May. May and August were both 50 cents lower, at $306.30 and $305.30 respectively.
